text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Loves Only You came to an end,
and from there, even more time passed—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, looks like it's about time.
Thank you all for tuning in
to today's stream!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Is it finally time~?" "Do your best!"
"Praying for your safety!" "It's already that time?!"
"Thanks for the stream!" "Take care!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Once I arrive and get settled in,
I'm planning to stream again, so look forward to it♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely show everyone at the Breeders' Cup the power of our love too!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"‘Guaranteed Victory!!’ ‘Sending Love~!’
‘Take care of yourself!’ ‘Good job, Love-chan!’
‘So hyped for the BC!’ ‘Soar high!’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
This was Loves Only You♡ See ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
...I wonder if everyone will be arriving soon?
Heeey, Love-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting~! Did I take too long?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Nope!
You're right on time♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm... glad. Considering your usual stream schedule...
and how methodical you are, Love-chan...
I figured right about now would be the best time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "It's finally here, Love-chan...! Burn bright at 200 mph and give the Breeders' Cup everything you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "So, once my Mile Championship is over, let's celebrate together! Promise!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ That sounds great!
We definitely have to do it♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Following Hong Kong, I pray that Loves-san's love
will blossom across the world once more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
When you safely return,
please allow me to welcome you with a bouquet of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wah, really!? I'm so excited...!
I promise I'll bloom brilliantly in America♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Please, Love-chan... be the first Japanese Umamusume
to win the Breeders' Cup...
and bring that victory home.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"And if so, our generation...
will surely become an even more glorious one...
that will go down in history."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I will achieve a love unprecedented in history. And then—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"The love from everyone has become my strength.
I'm going to go prove it!"
――May we offer some encouragement as well?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san! Lala-san!
Did you both come to see me...?!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"It's an honorable challenge taken on by a junior I competed with, after all.
Of course I'd want to at least say some words of encouragement."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just as Lala says.
Even if we're from different generations,
aren't we Umamusume who ran through the same era?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Go show the folks over there a truly magnificent run,
and steal the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'm lookin' forward to seein' ya standin' center stage, Loves-chan.
Give it yer all, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
I'll take center stage and become the lovely star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan.
Go carve out a new era overseas."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And let's run again.
Because I want to compete at full strength
against you, who created a legend of love, and win!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll definitely win... and run with Ai again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So please, look forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun♪
choice_data_list: Were you able to talk with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, sorry to keep you waiting♪
choice_data_list: Were you able to talk with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, all good♪ How about on your end?

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan! Look, a banner!
Good luck at the Breeders' Cup!
Our whole agency is rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waah, wonderful!!
I'm definitely going to win, so make sure you get the celebration ready♡

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: We're counting on you to build that bridge! Show us a historic first victory!!

text_block_list.name: Local Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck, you two!!"
"Have a great run!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Well then, I'm off!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...All that's left now is to board the plane.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, being sent off by everyone like this
as the two of us head toward the future... it feels kind of—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
No, it's nothing♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I take the outstretched hand and soar toward the awaiting battleground.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proof of my love for her is――――
not over yet.
